notes.subject: עמי נדיב
notes.rationale: Famously obscure: 'chariots of Amminadab' (KJV, a name) vs 'chariots of my princely people' (JPS/ASV) vs 'my people-nadib' as a title; the syntax will not resolve

notes.subject: לא ידעתי
notes.rationale: 'I knew not' — read as 'before I was aware' or 'I did not know myself' or 'I know not [what came over me]'

notes.subject: n ni
notes.rationale: נפשי is throat/life-force/self, not 'soul' in a later sense

notes.subject: verse whole
notes.rationale: Deliberately opaque verse whose imagery resists any single reading — the text withholds its meaning
